decode_rules.single_label: softmax over the attribute's slice, then argmax
decode_rules.multi_label: independent sigmoid per class; every class at or above multilabel_threshold is selected, and an empty set is a valid answer meaning 'the model ran and found none'
decode_rules.unknown: 'unknown' is an answer -- the model ran and judged the attribute unclear. It is not the same as inference never having run.

display_tiers.strong: Display prominently; safe to expose as a search facet.
display_tiers.moderate: Display, confidence-gated. A positive is more informative than a negative.
display_tiers.weak: Supporting detail only. Never a filter.
display_tiers.unvalidated: Per-class reliability unmeasured. Display without prominence.
display_tiers.hidden: Do not display or filter -- the model adds nothing over a constant.
